description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Detects position-registry lifecycle desyncs: a positions registry has add/remove/update mutators, and a position-mutating sibling either omits the registry update its siblings perform, or removes the entry without the emptiness guard a sibling remove has. Anchored on NOYA H-23 (DolomiteConnector.transferBetweenAccounts mutates the Dolomite position via borrowPositionProxy but omits registry.updateHoldingPosition that openBorrowPosition/closeBorrowPosition perform) and H-18 (closeBorrowPosition removes unconditionally; sibling withdraw guards on markets.length==0). DISTINCT from connector_position_accounting Shape C (single-function msg.sender-vs-calculatorConnector KEY mismatch — H-12, NOT duplicated here) and from sibling_function_parity (generic name/call kinship, which misses these because cores differ + jaccard<0.3). High precision over recall. NEVER mints or routes.

fp_controls.missing_registry_update_gate: shape 1 (H-23): the OMITTER must be external/public, non-view, call a subject method whose name carries a LIFECYCLE verb (transfer/move/open/close/create), share a subject-proxy object with a sibling that calls a registry_mutation_vocab fn, and itself omit any registry_mutation call. Amount-only verbs (borrow/repay/supply/withdraw/deposit/mint/burn/stake) are EXCLUDED as omitter triggers — they change amounts, not position membership (suppresses the Aave borrow/repay benign omit-groups seen in the corpus).
fp_controls.unguarded_registry_remove_gate: shape 2 (H-18): a function performs a registry REMOVE; a sibling remove on the same registry guards it with an emptiness/balance check (emptiness_guard_vocab); the function omits that guard.
fp_controls.view_pure_suppression: view/pure omitters dropped (the corpus _getPositionTVL / getX / maxDeposit noise).
fp_controls.not_shape_c: this lens does NOT flag the single-function msg.sender-vs-calculatorConnector key mismatch (connector_position_accounting Shape C / H-12).
fp_controls.wrapper_admin_suppression: forwarder + both-admin suppression reused from the parity machinery.
